definitions.explanation: The return of money paid, typically when goods are returned, services are not provided, or a purchase is canceled.

examples.japanese: {返金|へんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
{返金|へんきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦レシート→レシート：05291_reshiito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: A receipt is required for a refund.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb.
- {返金|へんきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to refund
- {返金|へんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a refund
- {返金|へんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to request a refund

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:

- ⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧{返金|へんきん}: partial refund
- {返金|へんきん}⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧: money-back guarantee
- {返金|へんきん}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: refund handling

- Online purchases typically have a ⟦{返品|へんぴん}→返品：05465_henpin⟧・{返金|へんきん}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (return/refund period)
